title: The Avogadro constant is fixed at 6.022 140 76 × 10²³ per mole
summary: BIPM marks NA exact and ties the revised mole to it.
body: BIPM prints the Avogadro constant NA as 6.022 140 76 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, with no uncertainty. The NIST 2022 listing prints 'Avogadro constant 6.022 140 76 e23 (exact) mol⁻¹'. BIPM's base-units page says the revised mole is based on this fixed value.

sources.title: The International System of Units (SI): Defining constants
sources.author: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures
sources.note: Page opened 2026-11-18. BIPM dates the fixed values to the revision that took effect on 20 May 2019 and cites CGPM Resolution 1 (2018).

sources.title: Fundamental Physical Constants, complete listing, 2022 CODATA adjustment
sources.author: NIST, CODATA 2022 recommended values
sources.note: Complete listing of the 2022 CODATA adjustment, opened 2026-11-18. Digits are copied from lines that were printed in full, without an ellipsis.

said_by: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures; NIST CODATA 2022
